queries.title: All Wikidata properties with label and description, ordered numerically

grammar.prefixes:
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT  ?property ?propertyType ?propertyLabel ?propertyDescription
WHERE
  { ?property  wikibase:propertyType  ?propertyType
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  rdfs:label  ?property__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  rdfs:label  ?property__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?property__label_value), ?property__label_value, if(( isURI(?property) && strstarts(str(?property), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?property), "entity/"), str(?property))) AS ?propertyLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  schema:description  ?property__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?property__description_value AS ?propertyDescription)
  }
ORDER BY ASC(xsd:integer(strafter(str(?property), "P")))

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT  ?id ?idLabel ?idDescription ?new
WHERE
  { ?id  wikibase:directClaim  ?pid
    MINUS
      { ?id  wikibase:propertyType  wikibase:ExternalId }
    BIND(replace(str(?id), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/P", " ") AS ?new)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?id  rdfs:label  ?id__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?id__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?id  rdfs:label  ?id__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?id__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?id__label_value), ?id__label_value, if(( isURI(?id) && strstarts(str(?id), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?id), "entity/"), str(?id))) AS ?idLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?id  schema:description  ?id__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?id__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?id__description_value AS ?idDescription)
  }
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:integer(?new))

grammar.prefixes:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?q ?langcode ?langLabel (COUNT(?label) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { VALUES ?q { wd:Q43459 }
    ?q rdfs:label|skos:altLabel ?label
    BIND(lang(?label) AS ?langcode)
    ?lang  wdt:P218  ?langcode
    OPTIONAL
      { ?lang  rdfs:label  ?lang__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?lang  rdfs:label  ?lang__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?lang__label_value), ?lang__label_value, if(( isURI(?lang) && strstarts(str(?lang), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?lang), "entity/"), str(?lang))) AS ?langLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?q ?langcode ?langLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

lex.wdt:P131?/wdt:P17: country (P17), directly or via located in the administrative territorial entity (P131)
lex.wdt:P131*/wdt:P17?/wdt:P31: optionally country (P17), directly or via located in the administrative territorial entity (P131) at any depth → instance of (P31)
lex.wd:Q3336843: constituent country of the United Kingdom (Q3336843)

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?p ?pLabel ?pDescription
WHERE
  { ?p  wdt:P31  wd:Q5 ;
        wdt:P21  wd:Q6581072
      { ?p  wdt:P19  wd:Q145 }
    UNION
      { ?p  wdt:P19  ?place
          { ?place (wdt:P131)?/wdt:P17 wd:Q145 }
        UNION
          { ?place ((wdt:P131)*/(wdt:P17)?)/wdt:P31 wd:Q3336843 }
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?p  rdfs:label  ?p__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?p__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?p  rdfs:label  ?p__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?p__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?p__label_value), ?p__label_value, if(( isURI(?p) && strstarts(str(?p), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?p), "entity/"), str(?p))) AS ?pLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?p  schema:description  ?p__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?p__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?p__description_value AS ?pDescription)
  }
ORDER BY ?pLabel

lex.p:P577/psv:P577: publication date statement (P577) → publication date value (full) (P577)
lex.rdfs:label: label (rdfs:label)

grammar.full:
PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  psv:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT  ?workLabel ?pubdate ?pubdatePrecision ?image ?typelabel ?english (URI(concat("https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=", substr(str(?work), 32))) AS ?reasonator) (if(bound(?english), ?english, ?reasonator) AS ?link)
WHERE
  { ?work  wdt:P50  wd:Q9068 ;
           wdt:P31  ?type .
    ?work p:P577/psv:P577 ?pubdateStatementNode
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q3331189 }
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q105420 }
    ?pubdateStatementNode
              wikibase:timeValue    ?pubdate ;
              wikibase:timePrecision  ?pubdatePrecision
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  wdt:P18  ?image }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?english  schema:about     ?work ;
                  schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "de" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?work__label_value), ?work__label_value, if(( isURI(?work) && strstarts(str(?work), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?work), "entity/"), str(?work))) AS ?workLabel)
    ?type  rdfs:label  ?typelabel
    FILTER ( lang(?typelabel) = "en" )
  }

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?work ?workLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sitelink) AS ?linkcount)
WHERE
  { ?work  wdt:P50  wd:Q9068
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q39811647 }
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q3331189 }
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q105420 }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?sitelink  schema:about  ?work
        FILTER contains(str(?sitelink), ".wikipedia.org/")
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "de" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?work__label_value), ?work__label_value, if(( isURI(?work) && strstarts(str(?work), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?work), "entity/"), str(?work))) AS ?workLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?work ?workLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?linkcount)

  { ?painting wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)* wd:Q3305213 .
    ?painting  wdt:P195  wd:Q190804 ;

              wdt:P186  wd:Q296955 ;

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT  ?poem ?poemLabel ?languageLabel ?authorLabel ?year
WHERE
  { ?poem wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q5185279
    OPTIONAL
      { ?poem  wdt:P577  ?pubdate }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?poem  wdt:P571  ?inception }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?poem  wdt:P50  ?author }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?poem  wdt:P407  ?language }
    BIND(if(bound(?pubdate), ?pubdate, ?inception) AS ?date)
    BIND(year(?date) AS ?year)
    FILTER ( ( ?year > 1699 ) && ( ?year < 1800 ) )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?poem  rdfs:label  ?poem__label_value

        FILTER ( lang(?language__label_value) = "en" )

    OPTIONAL
      { ?author  rdfs:label  ?author__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?author__label_value) = "en" )

queries.title: Works of Hans Sachs with links to their online text
queries.tierName: With value filters or computed columns

grammar.prefixes:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?work ?workLabel ?year ?text ?wikisource
WHERE
  { ?work  wdt:P50   wd:Q19543 ;
           wdt:P577  ?pubdate
    BIND(year(?pubdate) AS ?year)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?wikisource  schema:about  ?work ;
                  schema:isPartOf  <https://de.wikisource.org/>
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  wdt:P953  ?text }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "de" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?work__label_value), ?work__label_value, if(( isURI(?work) && strstarts(str(?work), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?work), "entity/"), str(?work))) AS ?workLabel)
  }
ORDER BY ?year

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?parliament ?parliamentLabel ?houseLabel (COUNT(?sen) AS ?members) (COUNT(?death) AS ?dead)
WHERE
  { ?parliament  wdt:P279  wd:Q486839
    OPTIONAL
      { ?parliament  wdt:P361  ?house }
    ?sen  wdt:P39  ?parliament
    OPTIONAL
      { ?sen  wdt:P570  ?death }
    FILTER ( ?parliament NOT IN (wd:Q928764, wd:Q1055894, wd:Q928764) )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?parliament  rdfs:label  ?parliament__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?parliament__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?parliament  rdfs:label  ?parliament__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?parliament__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?parliament__label_value), ?parliament__label_value, if(( isURI(?parliament) && strstarts(str(?parliament), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?parliament), "entity/"), str(?parliament))) AS ?parliamentLabel)
    BIND(if(bound(?house), ?house, "unbound") AS ?house__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?house__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?house__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?house__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?house__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?house__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?house__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?house__label_value), ?house__label_value, if(( isURI(?house) && strstarts(str(?house), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?house), "entity/"), str(?house))) AS ?houseLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?parliament ?parliamentLabel ?houseLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?members)

grammar.full:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?item ?itemLabel ?awardLabel ?rel ?langname ?wp
WHERE
  { VALUES ?award { wd:Q160082 wd:Q2052291 }
      { ?item  wdt:P166  ?award
        BIND("won" AS ?rel)
      }
    UNION
      { ?item  wdt:P1411  ?award
        BIND("nominated" AS ?rel)
      }
    MINUS
      { ?item  wdt:P31  wd:Q5 }
    MINUS
      { ?enwp  schema:about     ?item ;
               schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
      }
    ?wp  schema:about       ?item ;
         schema:inLanguage  ?langcode
    OPTIONAL
      { ?language  wdt:P218   ?langcode ;
                  rdfs:label  ?langlabel
        FILTER ( lang(?langlabel) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(coalesce(?langlabel, ?langcode) AS ?langname)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?item__label_value), ?item__label_value, if(( isURI(?item) && strstarts(str(?item), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?item), "entity/"), str(?item))) AS ?itemLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?award  rdfs:label  ?award__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?award__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?award  rdfs:label  ?award__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?award__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?award__label_value), ?award__label_value, if(( isURI(?award) && strstarts(str(?award), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?award), "entity/"), str(?award))) AS ?awardLabel)
  }
ORDER BY ?itemLabel

grammar.prefixes:

lex.{ ?recipient_male wdt:P166 ?award .\n?re: is the award received (P166) of something whose sex or gender (P21) includes male (Q6581097) | is the award received (P166) of something whose sex or gender (P21) includes female (Q6581072)

grammar.full:
#defaultView:BarChart
#title:Gender balance (%age women) for literary awards
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?award ?awardLabel (( round(( ( ?women * 1000 ) / ( ?men + ?women ) )) / 10 ) AS ?percent)
WHERE
  { { SELECT  (COUNT(?recipient_male) AS ?men) (COUNT(?recipient_female) AS ?women) ?award
      WHERE
        { ?award  wdt:P31  wd:Q378427
            { ?recipient_male
                        wdt:P166  ?award ;
                        wdt:P21   wd:Q6581097
            }
          UNION
            { ?recipient_female
                        wdt:P166  ?award ;
                        wdt:P21   wd:Q6581072
            }
        }
      GROUP BY ?award
      HAVING ( ( ?men + ?women ) > 50 )
    }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?award  rdfs:label  ?award__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?award__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?award  rdfs:label  ?award__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?award__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?award__label_value), ?award__label_value, if(( isURI(?award) && strstarts(str(?award), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?award), "entity/"), str(?award))) AS ?awardLabel)
  }
ORDER BY ?percent

PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT  (substr(str(?thing), 32) AS ?q) (substr(str(?prop), 37) AS ?p) (substr(str(?item), 32) AS ?itemq) ?itemLabel ?fullwork (substr(str(?coll), 32) AS ?collq) ?inventory ?url (GROUP_CONCAT(substr(str(?artist), 32) ; separator=' ') AS ?artists) (GROUP_CONCAT(?typeLabel ; separator=', ') AS ?types) ?from (year(?latest) AS ?to) ?precision
WHERE
  { VALUES ?coll { wd:Q636400 wd:Q82133 wd:Q1456119 wd:Q6941088 }
    ?item  p:P195   _:b0 .
    _:b0   ps:P195  ?coll ;
           pq:P217  ?inventory
    VALUES ?prop { wdt:P180 wdt:P170 wdt:P1774 wdt:P138 }
    ?item  ?prop    ?thing ;
           wdt:P31  ?type
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  wdt:P973  ?url
        FILTER ( contains(str(?url), ".ox.ac.uk") || contains(str(?url), "ashmolean.org") )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  wdt:P953  ?fullwork
        FILTER ( contains(str(?fullwork), ".ox.ac.uk") || contains(str(?fullwork), "ashmolean.org") )
      }
    FILTER ( bound(?fullwork) || bound(?url) )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  wdt:P170  ?artist }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  p:P571    _:b1 .
        _:b1   pq:P1319  ?earliest ;
               pq:P1326  ?latest
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item p:P571/psv:P571 _:b2 .
        _:b2  wikibase:timePrecision  ?precision ;
              wikibase:timeValue    ?year
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?earliest), year(?earliest), year(?year)) AS ?from)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?item__label_value), ?item__label_value, if(( isURI(?item) && strstarts(str(?item), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?item), "entity/"), str(?item))) AS ?itemLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?type__label_value), ?type__label_value, if(( isURI(?type) && strstarts(str(?type), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?type), "entity/"), str(?type))) AS ?typeLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?thing ?prop ?item ?itemLabel ?fullwork ?inventory ?url ?coll ?from ?latest ?precision
ORDER BY DESC(?prop) ?from ?to

grammar.full:
PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  pr:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/>
PREFIX  prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX  ps:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>

SELECT  ?type ?typeLabel ?typeDescription ?link
WHERE
  { ?type  p:P279   ?s .
    ?s     ps:P279  wd:Q744099 .
    ?s prov:wasDerivedFrom/pr:P854 ?link
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?type__label_value), ?type__label_value, if(( isURI(?type) && strstarts(str(?type), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?type), "entity/"), str(?type))) AS ?typeLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  schema:description  ?type__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?type__description_value AS ?typeDescription)
  }
